mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing lungs to circulation was most worthwhile because it brought the chapter’s parts together and showed how a breath serves distant cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the exchange surface to the lung spaces felt somewhat repetitive after the preceding result had already shown gas exchange, though the enlarged section clarified how air and blood stay separate.

surprise.text: The pleural membranes clarified how chest movement can make the lungs expand; I had been unsure how that connection worked.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although most decisions had only one offered combination, so I was following the available path rather than figuring out compatibility.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because connecting breathing to circulation made me curious how the remaining body systems will support cellular work. I would hope for more meaningful choices along the way.
